protocol.state_definition: previous draw's same ordered position P_i(t-1), binned by quartiles of the exact uniform-combination order-statistic prior
protocol.primary_endpoint: blind-OOS per-position Brier improvement (global shrinkage baseline minus state-conditioned candidate)
protocol.validation_selection: per position, maximize validation mean Brier improvement; tie-break lower alpha

bootstrap.type: circular moving block, centered-null one-sided benefit test

decision.reason: No blind-OOS Brier endpoint survives Holm across five positions; all 95% block-bootstrap intervals include zero. Position-specific lag-1 conditioning has no confirmed probabilistic lift.
preserved_candidates: P2: blind-OOS Brier improvement +0.0001412 (95% CI crosses zero; raw p=0.2904; Holm p=1); Top-1 +0.2577 pp but Top-5 -0.7732 pp.
P3: blind-OOS Top-5 delta +1.8041 pp; Brier improvement is negative (-0.0002756), Top-1 delta -0.5155 pp, so preserve as an exploratory rank anomaly only.
decision.root_cause: The prior order-statistic marginal dominates; conditioning on a previous-position quartile state introduces sparse 36-outcome counts and variance. Validation-selected alpha=500 for each position still does not produce stable blind-OOS scoring gains.

next_action: PSR-04: test a continuous same-position lag-1 transition kernel with prior shrinkage and a validation-frozen bandwidth grid; preserve P2's small Brier candidate and P3's Top-5 anomaly. Keep the exact order-statistic marginal as baseline, use identical blind dates and Holm across five positions. No motor change.

execution.runtime: JavaScript V8; runtime version omitted for deterministic output
execution.output_policy: append-only research artifacts; no engine promotion
